Wellness & Medical Disclaimer

Effective September 24, 2026 · Version 2.7

One sentence. Remvoll is a comfort and ambiance product — it is not medicine, not a medical device, and it does not diagnose, treat, or promise any health outcome.

1. No medical advice or professional relationship

The Service, including all audio, features, text, and analytics, is provided for general informational, entertainment, comfort, and ambiance purposes only. It does not constitute medical, psychological, sleep-medicine, or other professional advice, and no doctor-patient, therapist-client, or other professional relationship is created by your use of it. Never disregard, avoid, or delay obtaining professional advice because of anything you have accessed through the Service. Always consult a qualified health professional before making decisions about your health, sleep, medication, or treatment.

2. Not a medical device

Remvoll is not a medical device and has not been reviewed, cleared, or approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration, the European Medicines Agency, the UK MHRA, or any other regulatory authority. It is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, mitigate, monitor, or prevent any disease, disorder, or condition, including but not limited to insomnia and other sleep disorders, sleep apnea, snoring, anxiety, depression, stress disorders, tinnitus, ADHD, or pain.

3. What Remvoll actually is

  • A generator of layered natural soundscapes designed so that the audio does not audibly repeat.
  • An audible "Breath Entrainment" layer — a slow swell in the sound's level and tone at a breaths-per-minute pace you select — offered as a gentle pacing cue you may choose to breathe along with or ignore.
  • A private, on-device log describing your own listening activity, and a Sleep Score that summarizes it.

4. What Remvoll is not

  • A pacing cue, not a therapy. Breath Entrainment plays an audible rhythm you may voluntarily breathe along with. It does not monitor, measure, or force your breathing, it is not a medical breathing therapy or biofeedback device, and it makes no claim to alter your heart rate, brainwaves, or any physiological process. Slow, voluntary paced breathing is something many people simply find relaxing.
  • Not a sleep tracker or diagnostic tool. Sleep history describes application playback (duration, sounds, settings, playback interruptions), never your body. The Sleep Score summarizes one night from what was recorded: how long the sound played or, if you allow Apple Health, how long your tracker recorded you as asleep, how continuously, how much of it was deep and REM sleep and how quickly you fell asleep; how close to your usual hour the night began; whether Smart Wake found a light moment; and, as a small factor, how often the night was disturbed. It is a wellness estimate of how restful the night was, not a medical measurement or a health assessment, it has not been validated against clinical sleep measurement, and it is only as accurate as the device that recorded the night. Remvoll has no sensors of its own and makes no diagnosis. Where you grant Health access it reads sleep and overnight samples (heart rate, heart rate variability, breathing rate, blood oxygen, wrist temperature) read-only, on your device, only to time Smart Wake and to work out and show the Sleep Score, and keeps a statistical summary of your sleep timing (not the samples) so that it can keep doing so without a Watch; where you enable room listening it reads a loudness level from the microphone without recording, storing, or transmitting any audio. A morning note, if you choose to record one, is the single exception: it is a recording you make on purpose, kept encrypted on your device, replaced by the next one, and never uploaded.
  • Not a substitute for care. Persistent sleep difficulty, breathing problems during sleep, mood disturbances, or other health concerns deserve evaluation by a qualified professional.
  • Not a safety device. Do not rely on Remvoll for alerting, monitoring, or any life-safety purpose.

5. No clinical testing; no proven or guaranteed results

Remvoll has not been clinically tested. The Service, including its Breath Entrainment feature, has not been evaluated in clinical trials or validated by any independent scientific study, and no regulatory authority has reviewed any claim about it. Any benefits are not scientifically proven, and no results are guaranteed or implied. While published research exists on slow, voluntarily paced breathing generally, that research was not conducted on this product, may not generalize to it, and is not evidence that Remvoll produces any outcome.

Individual responses to sound vary widely. We make no representation or warranty that the Service will help you fall asleep, stay asleep, relax, reduce stress, change your breathing, or produce any other particular result. Any general statements about relaxation or comfort describe design intent, not promises of outcomes for you. You assume all responsibility for your reliance on the Service.

6. Health, safety, and responsible-use warnings

  • Attention. Do not use the Service while driving or operating machinery, or in any situation where you need to remain alert or hear your surroundings.
  • Alarms. Set a volume that keeps smoke, carbon-monoxide, security, medical, baby-monitor, and other alarms clearly audible throughout the night.
  • Hearing. Extended listening at high volume, especially through headphones or earbuds, can damage hearing. Keep the volume moderate and take breaks.
  • Sound sensitivity. Some individuals are sensitive to certain sounds or low-frequency content. If you experience discomfort, anxiety, headache, nausea, dizziness, ear pain, or any adverse reaction, stop immediately and consult a professional if symptoms persist.
  • Vulnerable users. If you are pregnant, have a seizure disorder, a cardiovascular or respiratory condition, a psychiatric condition, or any other health concern, consult your clinician before regular use.
  • Children. Use around infants and children should be supervised by a responsible adult, with special attention to volume and the audibility of monitors.

7. Third-party and general information

Any general educational statements within the app about sound, sleep hygiene, or circadian rhythm (for example, jet-lag guidance) are simplified, non-personalized, and provided for interest only. They are not tailored to your circumstances and should not be relied upon as professional guidance. Light exposure and timing — not audio — are the primary drivers of circadian adjustment; the jet-lag feature is a supportive routine, not a clinical intervention.

8. Emergencies

The Service is not designed to assist in emergencies. If you are experiencing a medical or psychological emergency, or are in crisis, contact your local emergency number or a crisis line immediately.

9. Why our language is deliberately careful

Slow, pleasant audio is widely enjoyed, but rigorous clinical evidence that any consumer soundscape improves measurable sleep outcomes is limited. We choose to under-claim rather than borrow credibility from science that is not established. Every part of the app is written to follow this rule; if you ever encounter marketing or copy that appears to make a health claim inconsistent with this disclaimer, please report it and we will correct it.

10. Assumption of risk and limitation

By using the Service you acknowledge and accept the informational, comfort-only nature of the product and agree that your use is at your own discretion and risk. This disclaimer supplements, and is subject to, the disclaimers of warranties and limitation-of-liability provisions in the Terms of Service, which are incorporated here by reference. Nothing in this disclaimer excludes or limits liability that cannot be excluded or limited under applicable law, including liability for death or personal injury caused by gross negligence or willful misconduct.
